dedupe_keys.name: cartorisque prim net flood hazard datasets

description: cartorisque.prim.net: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by cartorisque.prim.net. Coverage: the area served by cartorisque.prim.net. The listing groups 188 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Atlas des zones inondables du Rhins et de la Trambouze; Plan de Prévention du Risque Inondation Pontrieux; Plan de Prévention du Risque Inondation de l'Ornel; Service de visualisation cartographique (WFS ) de Plan de Prévention d. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
